title: Comint subprocess rootfs identity

environment.system_features: ACL GMP GNUTLS LIBSELINUX LIBXML2 MODULES NATIVE_COMP NOTIFY INOTIFY PDUMPER SECCOMP SQLITE3 THREADS TREE_SITTER ZLIB

mechanism: Comint subprocesses must inherit the same rootfs contract as Emacs when they are part of a benchmark task.
hypothesis: A shell process launched through Comint should report the same run id and current directory; production mode must additionally prove tool resolution inside the selected rootfs.
minimal_fixture: One short-lived Comint subprocess that prints cwd, run id, PATH, and Python resolution.
predicted_behavior: The subprocess observes the Insula run id, but development mode remains a non-hermetic host-bind classification.
observed_behavior:
prod=t run-id="20260930T040324Z-4018462" output="cwd=/workspace/soma
run_id=20260930T040324Z-4018462
python=/usr/bin/python3
path=/opt/soma/emacs/bin:/opt/soma/cargo/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin

Process soma-comint-rootfs-probe finished
"

counterexample: A process-buffer benchmark can pass with the right output while the shell and tools came from the host runtime.
derived_gym_requirement: Comint benchmark graders must record process identity, cwd, PATH/tool resolution, rootfs manifest, and timeout/unknown state before trusting process output.
